locations.title: The Wagon Clearing
locations.subtitle: THE OLD TRADE ROAD
locations.description: The broken wagon stands beneath the trees. Its wheels have sunk into the mud, and the campfire has burned low. Scattered crates bear the stamps of Seabrook merchants.
locations.revisit_text: The abandoned wagon is familiar now. Its ruined canvas stirs in the breeze. You remember the clues you found here, and the way the raiders moved through the woods.

choices.label: Search the wagon and scattered crates

success.text: Among the broken crates you find a partial freight manifest, with a shipment missing from the tally.

effects.text: A partial manifest reveals a missing mineral consignment.

failure.text: The wagon has been badly disturbed. You cannot establish what was taken.

effects.text: The party searched the wagon but found no reliable manifest.

choices.label: Follow the goblin tracks into the woods

success.text: The tracks skirt a fallen oak, then descend towards an overgrown ravine path.

effects.text: Goblin tracks lead towards an overgrown ravine trail.

failure.text: The prints disappear amongst older tracks and wet limestone gravel. Someone in town may know the road better.

effects.text: The party lost the goblin trail; the hideout remains undiscovered.

choices.label: Take the discovered ravine path
Continue towards Harrowford

locations.title: The Northern Road
locations.subtitle: ON THE WAY TO HARROWFORD
locations.description: The Old Trade Road cuts through open valleys. Beyond the fields, the high moor rises against grey mountains. Ahead, roofs cluster around an ore weighhouse.

choices.label: Enter Harrowford and report to the guild
Visit the trading post and market
Return to the wagon clearing

locations.title: Harrowford Adventurers' Guild
locations.subtitle: THE MARKET TOWN
locations.description: The guild occupies a sturdy stone-fronted hall. An overworked clerk listens carefully to the report of the goblin attack and opens Tavian Marr's contract ledger.
locations.revisit_text: The guild's noticeboard is familiar. The clerk has not forgotten your account of the road ambush.

choices.label: Report the ambush under Tavian Marr's contract

effects.text: The party reported the ambush to Harrowford's Adventurers' Guild.

choices.result: The clerk records the surviving details of the ambush. The guild expects a fuller account when the caravan mystery is solved.

choices.label: Ask why ore deliveries have slowed

effects.text: The guild confirms ore shipments are sporadic, though the dwarves insist nothing is wrong.

choices.result: The clerk admits the ore consignments have become unreliable. Mine representatives say their workings are sound, but the weighhouse records suggest otherwise.

choices.label: Visit the Stoneweight Trading Post
Return to the northern road

locations.title: Stoneweight Trading Post
locations.subtitle: HARROWFORD MARKET
locations.description: Ore scales stand beside market stalls. A woman with a worn wagoner's coat watches traders argue over missing consignments. She introduces herself as Mara Venn.
locations.revisit_text: Mara Venn recognises you among the traders. Empty ore carts still wait beside the scales.

choices.label: Ask Mara about the goblin raids

effects.text: Mara Venn knows a route to the goblin ravine beyond the wagon clearing.
Mara Venn offered reliable directions to the raiders' ravine.

choices.result: Mara has suffered the same raiders. She describes a split rock beside the ravine trail, offers a modest reward for stopping the attacks, and marks your overland map. No further check is needed.

choices.label: Accept Mara's offer to investigate the raiders

effects.text: The party accepted Mara Venn's request to investigate the raiders.

choices.result: Mara nods. 'Bring an end to the attacks, and we shall make sure you are paid.'

choices.label: Return to the Adventurers' Guild
Leave town by the northern road

locations.title: The Overgrown Ravine
locations.subtitle: OFF THE OLD TRADE ROAD
locations.description: A narrow track disappears between wet limestone walls. Bent branches and goblin prints confirm that this is no ordinary animal path. Up the valley, woodland gathers around a pale rock face. The goblins' cave lies somewhere ahead.

choices.label: Mark the likely hideout approach in your journal

effects.text: The ravine likely leads towards the goblins' hideout.
The party scouted the overgrown ravine but did not enter a cave.

choices.result: You sketch the narrow limestone pass and the wooded valley beyond. The way towards the cave mouth is now clear.

choices.label: Return to the wagon clearing
Travel onward towards Harrowford
Follow the ravine to the wooded cave approach

locations.title: Wooded Valley — Cave Approach
locations.subtitle: GOBLIN HIDEOUT • OUTSIDE
locations.description: A limestone wall rises above the narrow valley, its pale face streaked with rain. Dark undergrowth hides a cave mouth beneath dangling roots. Branches move overhead although there is little wind. The trees would make an excellent lookout.
locations.revisit_text: The limestone wall and cave mouth are familiar. The woodland above still offers excellent cover for anyone on watch.

choices.label: Carefully scan the trees for sentries (Perception DC 12)

success.text: Two small figures crouch in a crude platform among the branches. One keeps a bow close; the other watches the trail. You have spotted the ambushers before they spring their trap.

effects.text: Two goblin sentries occupy a hidden tree watchpost overlooking the cave approach.
The party spotted two hidden goblin lookouts before entering the cave.

failure.text: Shadows shift between the branches, but you cannot confirm whether anyone is watching. Moving closer may expose the party.

effects.text: The party searched for lookouts at the cave but could not confirm their position.

choices.label: Circle behind the discovered watchpost (Stealth DC 12)

success.text: You slip into a concealed position behind the two sentries. The goblins have not noticed you. If you choose to pass their watchpost, this position improves your chances. A direct watchpost battle will be added in the next combat milestone.

effects.text: The party reached concealed positions behind the goblin tree watchpost.

failure.text: A twig snaps. Both sentries turn and shout towards the cave. The watchpost has raised the alarm, though the party can still retreat or approach the entrance.

effects.text: The goblin watchpost detected the party and raised the alarm.

choices.label: Slip past the watchpost to the cave mouth (Stealth DC 13)

success.text: The party slips between the trunks and reaches the cave mouth without drawing the sentries' notice. The guards remain at their post; they have not been defeated.

effects.text: The party bypassed the two goblin lookouts without fighting.

failure.text: One of the goblins catches a glimpse of movement and cries out. You reach cover by the cave mouth, but a warning echoes inside; the sentries are still at their post.

effects.text: The party reached the cave entrance but the tree lookouts sounded an alarm.

choices.label: Approach the cave mouth openly despite the lookout risk

effects.text: The party approached the cave openly and the tree sentries warned the occupants.

choices.result: Two goblins call a warning from the branches as you hurry into cover at the rock face. Their alarm carries into the passage. You have not fought or captured the sentries.

choices.label: Mark the discovered tree watchpost on your local map

effects.text: The party recorded the hidden goblin watchpost on a local cave sketch.

choices.result: You draw the lookout platform high in the trees and mark the two goblin sentries. They remain at their post.

choices.label: Go to the cave mouth
Withdraw to the ravine

locations.title: Tree Watchpost
locations.subtitle: GOBLIN HIDEOUT • HIDDEN FEATURE
locations.description: A rough timber platform hides two goblin sentries among dense branches.

locations.title: Cave Entrance
locations.subtitle: GOBLIN HIDEOUT • LIMESTONE WALL
locations.description: The cave mouth opens beneath hanging roots. Cool, damp air carries the smell of woodsmoke and stone. A long passage disappears into the dark. The woodland behind you offers a way back.
locations.revisit_text: The damp cave entrance is familiar. The passage ahead vanishes into the pale limestone.

choices.label: Listen for sounds deeper inside (Perception DC 11)

success.text: Past distant voices and the drip of water you hear a steady rumble, as though water is falling somewhere underground.

effects.text: A large volume of water can be heard deep in the goblin cave, beyond the entrance.

failure.text: The cave swallows each sound and returns indistinct echoes.

effects.text: The party listened at the cave entrance but could not identify distant noises.

choices.label: Enter the limestone corridor
Step back outside the cave

locations.title: First Passage
locations.subtitle: GOBLIN HIDEOUT • UNDERGROUND
locations.description: The first stretch of corridor runs deep into the limestone. Light from outside dwindles behind you. A faint breeze carries damp air and old woodsmoke. Farther in, passages divide; those deeper rooms are not explorable in this build.
locations.revisit_text: The first underground passage still runs towards deeper chambers. There are no encounters in the completed entrance section.

choices.label: Record the direction of the deeper passage

effects.text: The goblin cave continues deeper into limestone passages beyond the explored entrance.
The party mapped the first stretch of the goblin cave corridor.

choices.result: You mark the corridor's direction on your local dungeon chart. The deeper guardrooms and waterfall are for a later expedition.

choices.label: Return to the cave mouth
